# ComfyUI Workflow Inspector

ComfyUI Workflow Inspector is a browser-only static tool for inspecting ComfyUI
UI workflow exports and prompt API JSON before hosting, repairing, or moving a
workflow to services such as RunningHub, Comfy Cloud, RunPod, or a private API.

Main page: <https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/>

Workflow diff:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/diff.html>

RunningHub output retrieval planner:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/runninghub.html>

Hosted ComfyUI parameter mapper:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/params.html>

ComfyUI custom node dependency scanner:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/dependencies.html>

ComfyUI API smoke test builder:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/api.html>

ComfyUI workflow repair brief builder:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/repair.html>

GitHub: <https://github.com/william08190/comfyui-workflow-inspector>

Hosted MV Studio version:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/comfyui-workflow-inspector.html?source=github>

Private workflow setup and repair:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/comfyui-runninghub-workflow-repair.html?source=github-inspector>

Setup deposit:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/service-checkout.html?package=workflow-setup-starter&source=github-inspector>

The tool parses JSON locally in the browser and does not upload workflow files.
It reports output-like nodes, preview-only branches, duration/frame/FPS fields,
prompt-bearing nodes, seed fields, model references, and a copyable repair brief.

The workflow diff page compares two workflow JSON files locally and reports added
nodes, removed nodes, node type changes, changed fields, output node changes, and
a copyable migration brief.

The RunningHub output retrieval planner identifies preferred final output node
ids, preview or temp nodes to avoid, ComfyUI `/history/{prompt_id}` lookup paths,
`/view` download steps, and a copyable hosted retrieval brief.

The parameter mapper identifies prompt, seed, dimension, timing, media upload,
and model fields that should become hosted API inputs, then generates source
paths and a copyable integration brief.

The dependency scanner identifies custom node package groups, unknown node
classes, model/checkpoint references, media file references, ffmpeg-sensitive
video nodes, and a copyable host setup brief.

The API smoke test builder identifies the preferred output node, preview-output
risks, bindable parameters, `/prompt`, `/history/{prompt_id}`, `/view`, and
websocket endpoints, then generates curl commands and a copyable smoke test
handoff brief.

The repair brief builder combines workflow JSON and optional failure logs into a
checkout-ready repair scope covering custom nodes, model and media assets,
runtime parameters, final output retrieval, hosted API verification, and a
copyable private setup handoff.
